title: Explicit affine basis germs and their linear combination map
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an affine open with affine chart hU, x in U, A = Gamma(X,U), and R = O_{X,x} [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Write Phi = affinePerfectSheafification [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model] and H = Phi followed by ordinary open direct image and the ambient module stalk. Identify Phi(A) with the unit sheaf on the slice by tildeSelf, restrictUnitIso, and the unit of overEquiv. Its unit section on U has germ b in H(A). For each n and p in Fin(n), let i_p : A -> ULift(Fin(n) -> A) send a to the tuple supported at p with value a, and put b_p = H(i_p)(b). Define c_n : ULift(Fin(n) -> R) -> H(ULift(Fin(n) -> A)) by c_n(v) = sum_p v_p b_p. Also define c : R -> H(A) by c(r) = r b, coordinate projections pi_p(v) = v_p, and scalar endomorphisms mu_a(r) = a r. All maps are concrete linear maps; H is additive and c_n(e_p) = b_p.

proof.text: Compose tildeSelf, restrictUnitIso, the inverse over equivalence and its unit isomorphism to construct the regular sheaf isomorphism. Push its inverse forward and take the germ of its unit section. Define coordinate inclusions, projections, scalar endomorphisms and the linear-combination maps explicitly.

For additivity of the stalk functor, represent a vector by a germ and use additivity of germs and sectionwise addition of morphisms. Tilde and the inverse over equivalence preserve binary biproducts, hence are additive; restriction is isomorphic to pullback, and ordinary direct image is additive sectionwise. Their composite is additive. Evaluation of the linear-combination map on a standard coordinate vector is the finite sum supported at that coordinate.

def affineFreeStalkComparison (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) (U : X.Opens)
    (hxU : x ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (n : ℕ) :
